'''Arko Santis''' was the father of [[Brom Santis]]. Arko wanted a voice in how the [[Dessain Mining]] was run by the [[Dessain family]], but the Dessains were loath to cede control to anyone who was not family. Consequently Arko's oldest son [[Brom Santis]] was to marry the daughter of [[Eomin Dessain]], [[Oma Dessain]].<ref name="Eruption" />
